steps.comment: quest_desertrescue.rs2:408-409,417-445: pushing the mine doors with all three slave garments worn teleports to 3301,3028 on the surface; without them a guard spawns and jails the player (446-460), so the three equip steps precede this.

Winch, surface barrel, cart loading, driver bribe and cart ride as one cursor. Stages 22-26 share the stage-19 journal line (desertrescue_journal.rs2:195-199), so a restart part-way is routed from item/area and chat evidence, not the stage number. Stage 22 holds no barrel (the lift guard takes it, camp_guard.rs2:200-202): underground it leaves via exit-mine-ana-on-lift, on the surface the winch pull advances it to 23 (quest_desertrescue.rs2:886-892). Stage 24 holds thanainabarrel on the surface (quest_desertrescue.rs2:724-727) and skips straight to the cart loading. Stage 25 bribes (mine_cart_driver.rs2:100-110 sets ready_rescue; an already-bribed driver just says 'Hurry up, get in the cart') and rides; stage 26 is outside the camp at 3258,3029 holding Ana (quest_desertrescue.rs2:367-371), so this whole cursor is skipped off-surface and return-ana takes over. With the chat ring intact the pickup line routes 23 vs 25; after a relog stage 23 (Ana in the upper barrel, ana_lift_barrel bit, quest_desertrescue.rs2:716-727) and stage 25 (barrel on the cart, ana_mining_cart bit, loading is a message box, quest_desertrescue.rs2:392-398) are not observably distinct: the winch then gives a stone and the barrel search is skipped, which is right at 25 and leaves Ana behind at 23 (pending). Selecting the surface steps individually re-picked the winch, hence one cursor. A jailed player has no authored recovery here (parks: no step for stage).
